name: Draco Dwarf
tagline: A very metal-poor Milky Way satellite 260,000 light-years out — one of the most dark-matter-dominated galaxies known.
history: Draco is a ghost of a galaxy — an extremely faint, very metal-poor swarm of ancient stars spread thinly across the halo. Its measured internal motions are far too fast for its visible mass: Draco's stars orbit inside a dark halo tens of times heavier than its starlight, making it a canonical site for studying how dark matter behaves at the smallest galactic scales.
